objective: maximize verified shipping speed and quality while preserving evidence, rollback and external authorization boundaries
automatic: detect broken local email asset paths
create safe branches and pull requests
retry deterministic CI failures when appropriate
remove duplicate or orphaned implementation artifacts

conditional.merge: only after required repository gates and release evidence pass; never bypass protected governance
conditional.publish_or_deploy: requires the repository's release approval/evidence contract and authorized provider access
conditional.secrets_or_credentials: never invent, expose or commit; use approved secret stores/provider authorization
conditional.spend_or_paid_resources: requires explicit authorized budget and provider controls
conditional.destructive_changes: must be minimal, recoverable and supported by evidence

anti_patterns: architecture phases without visible capability gain
duplicate frameworks for the same concern
heavy scheduled CI without measured value
self-claims of production state from repository state alone
